newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PDCP sets terms for preferred share offer.
newsitem.headline: PDCP sets terms for preferred share offer.

text.p: The PDCP Development Bank has set the offer period for its one billion peso preferred share issue between October 8 and October 21 this year, the bank said on Monday.

Corporate secretary Mario Lorenzo told the Philippine Stock Exchange the 100 million preferred shares could be bought by its shareholders at a ratio of 1.557281 preferred shares for each common share held as of September 8.
The preferred shares will not be listed on the bourse.
The preferred shares, which have a dividend rate of 4.5 percent payable every quarter, could be redeemed at the option of the issuer anytime after six months from the end of the offer.

Shareholders can convert their shares into common share after two years with a 10 percent premium over the weighted average price quoted 10 trading days before the offering period. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
